title: Douglas Elliman Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Douglas Elliman Inc. (real estate brokerage firm) filed Form 8-K disclosing dismissal of Deloitte & Touche LLP as its independent auditor and appointment of EisnerAmper LLP as replacement, effective April 6, 2026. The change was approved by the Board on Audit Committee recommendation. No disagreements or reportable events with the former auditor were disclosed.
key_points: Dismissed Deloitte & Touche LLP as independent auditor effective April 6, 2026
Appointed EisnerAmper LLP as replacement auditor for fiscal year ending December 31, 2026
Decision approved by Board of Directors on Audit Committee recommendation
Deloitte's audit reports for fiscal years 2025 and 2024 contained no adverse opinions, disclaimers, or qualifications
No 'disagreements' or 'reportable events' (as defined by Regulation S-K Item 304) with Deloitte occurred during the relevant periods
Letter from Deloitte dated April 8, 2026 filed as Exhibit 16.1
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate governance filing announcing an accounting firm change. It has no relevance to monetary policy, market structure, or macro financial conditions. Only relevant to Douglas Elliman shareholders and those monitoring the company's governance.

human_review.notes: Not relevant to market structure or macro catalysts. 8-K filing documents routine auditor change at a real estate company. No policy signal, no market implications.
